title: Craftable barrier and structure void
description: Craft a barrier and a structure void in survival
body:
This datapack adds craftable barrier and structure void.
# Recipes (like on screenshots):
## barrier:
red glass, glass, red glass
glass, redstone block, glass
red glass, glass, red glass
## structure void:
cyan glass, glass, cyan glass
glass, lapis block, glass
cyan glass, glass, cyan glass
